name: her tears were my light
source:
HER TEARS WERE MY LIGHT is a visual novel created for NaNoRenO 2016. It's a short love story about time and space. As time, you can move forward, backward, or warp to any moment you create a save point for. Can you use that power to save space from her feelings of loneliness?

[From [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/her-tears-were-my-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《她的眼泪是我的光》是为NaNoRenO 2016创作的视觉小说。这是一个关于时间和空间的简短爱情故事。随着时间的推移，你可以向前、向后或扭曲到你为其创建保存点的任何时刻。你能利用这种力量来为她的孤独感节省空间吗？

[来自[url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/her-tears-were-my-light]Itch.io[/url]]
